mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM product WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY name
SELECT * FROM product WHERE expire_on IS NOT NULL AND expire_on >= #{today} AND expire_on <= date(#{today}, '+' || #{days} || ' day') ORDER BY expire_on
SELECT * FROM product WHERE is_active = 1 AND ((safety_qty > 0 AND stock_qty <= safety_qty) OR (safety_qty = 0 AND stock_qty <= #{globalWarn})) ORDER BY stock_qty
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_active = 1 AND ((safety_qty > 0 AND stock_qty <= safety_qty) OR (safety_qty = 0 AND stock_qty <= #{globalWarn}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE expire_on IS NOT NULL AND expire_on >= #{today} AND expire_on <= date(#{today}, '+' || #{days} || ' day')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(name, barcode, sale_price_cent, cost_price_cent, stock_qty, safety_qty, expire_on, is_active, created_at, spec, category, shelf_life_days, default_supplier_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{barcode}, #{salePriceCent}, #{costPriceCent}, #{stockQty}, #{safetyQty}, #{expireOn}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{spec}, #{category}, #{shelfLifeDays}, #{defaultSupplierId})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock_qty = stock_qty - #{qty} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock_qty >= #{qty}
UPDATE product SET stock_qty = stock_qty + #{qty} WHERE id = #{id}
